Gold.note: Strong momentum and central bank buying support safe-haven demand.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and precious metal demand drives strong price momentum.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and electrification demand underpin strong upside.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed nuclear build-out support prices.

Lithium.note: Persisting oversupply and inventory destocking weigh on near-term prices.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and negative momentum create bearish pressure.

Zinc.note: Mine supply constraints and strong momentum support higher prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and high port inventories cap upside.

Coal.note: Adequate global inventories and energy transition headwinds limit upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks offset by currently weak EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Stable steel production balances against nascent battery demand.

PGM.note: Weak global auto sales offset by long-term hydrogen catalyst potential.

Potash.note: Normalizing global supply chains and adequate farmer inventories weigh on prices.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and strong green energy demand support prices.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket provides balanced exposure to global macro recovery.
